title: Large personal Amiga/ST/CPC/DOS engines and WordStar recovery discovery
summary: Personally screen 466 candidate URLs and add 18 projects, with six explicit non-promotion decisions.
notes: Root personally searched 12 GitHub query routes, screened 466 unique URLs and inspected 24 pinned repository trees. Eighteen additions and six explicit non-promotions. Native recovered routines, binary save/document formats, original interpreter patches and preserved replay source are distinguished from CPU runtimes, modern tributes and empty descriptions. No upstream code, game, converter, emulator, disk writer or service was executed.

sources.reason: Behavioral reconstruction from original executable research, with native DAT archive decoding and game systems. Inspected RLE4 decoder and application/game integration.
Rebuilds PART2.EXE gameplay into native object/collision/callback systems. Inspected structured fixed-point object bounds and explicit unported-path counter.
Restunts-derived semantic C port of original simulation and renderer. Inspected named CARSTATE arithmetic with original assembly retained in comments, rather than a generic instruction dispatcher.
Native sprite archive decoder derived from tracing ZED.EXE blit routine. Inspected offsets, VGA palette, alignment and Mode-X planar decoding, not guessed generic RLE.
Converts remaster SCUMM save blocks to original DOS layouts, rewriting heap headers, class table and scale tables. Inspected actual conversion and donor-state handling.
New annotated C reconstruction of 1983 COM exists alongside older Unix port used for names/cross-checks. Inspected original-address bag records, movement routines and module coverage.
Reimplements original binary-only GEMDOS pool extension TSR. Inspected filename-derived folder count, supervisor boot device lookup and resident memory allocation behavior.

Native semantic game routines coexist with separate Z80 reference build. Inspected structured player loop/unwinding and documented routine dispatch by original address. Retains 64 KB memory, register contracts and some flag helpers.
Decodes original 21 map grids and 16 graphics banks with disk-derived previews and bounded map export. Inspected exact map dimensions, disk size and binary access model.
Commented and improved music-player disassembly with decoded module structures and explicit per-frame/subsong/effect interface. Inspected replay source and hardware-oriented state descriptions.

Analyzes and patches original Sierra ST AGI 1.422 interpreter plus demake bytecode. Inspected guarded heap-size patch and original-context matching. Adds mouse/hotspot support and repairs sound/memory bugs.
Derivative of StuntCarRemake with Amiga-referenced car behavior and explicit original suspension constants. Inspected substantial preserved car simulation, not just recreated track appearance.

Modern Lotus-inspired spreadsheet includes substantive original WK1 record reader and formula bytecode compiler/decompiler. Inspected actual format code, which makes it more than a visual slash-menu tribute.
Converts WordStar binary formatting controls, symmetrical blocks, dot commands and notes into Markdown/text. Inspected actual control mapping and command handling.
Parses WordStar 3–7 control streams and style libraries with text/Markdown/RTF export and limited write-back. Inspected WS5–7 symmetric-sequence and note models.
Swift WordStar viewer/converter models note blocks, dot commands, style and print behavior; inspected source-provenanced document model derived from ctrl-kd.
Modular binary-text conversion handles WordStar high-bit encoding, EOF, alignment and Unicode output. Inspected stream masking and end marker behavior.
Reconstructs CPC 6128 BASIC 1.1 tokens, expression and execution semantics using original disassembly as behavioral reference. Inspected original-address-backed token catalogue and emitter.
Pinned tree contains only .gitignore. Repository description is not evidence of an implemented Marsport port.

Lotus-style modern spreadsheet backed by IronCalc and XLSX, with UI/tutorial acceptance contracts. Reviewed evidence does not establish original Lotus binary-format or algorithm recovery; keep modern compatibility lead distinct from restoration.
Current recovery explicitly derives from ZX Spectrum assets/gameplay; Atari ST appears in platform comparison notes, not an implemented ST recovery. Relevant outside this four-platform focused pass.
New Greaseweazle frontend inspired by X-COPY. Amiga disk functionality alone does not establish recovery of the original application source or algorithms.
Historical add-on/patch collection dominated by packaged tools, with TKM assembly present. No reconstructed Tornado engine or cohesive application restoration established in this bounded review.
Explicitly Directory Opus-inspired tribute with no original Opus code; broad modern file-manager and retro-tool integration rather than original application recovery.

decisions.reason: Historical add-on/patch collection dominated by packaged tools, with TKM assembly present. No reconstructed Tornado engine or cohesive application restoration established in this bounded review.

decisions.title: lastylegp/Quopus
decisions.reason: Explicitly Directory Opus-inspired tribute with no original Opus code; broad modern file-manager and retro-tool integration rather than original application recovery.
